# Bundled DeepSeek Harness installer

`dsh-installer.exe` is the complete Windows x64 installer already present in the local Downloads directory; it is copied byte-for-byte, with no user credentials or configuration injected.

Gezhi shows a connection guide on first launch. If not installed, it starts this program's normal installation wizard; if already installed, it can open the official DeepSeek Harness window for login. Account verification is performed by DeepSeek Harness. Gezhi's version check does not impersonate account verification.

The accompanying LICENSE comes from the current DeepSeek Harness runtime; the original installer also retains all of its third-party licenses. Upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

File digests and copy records are in manifest.json. This directory does not contain DSH_HOME, accounts, sessions, or user settings.
